messages:
emma: FYI customer reports a 400 from /v1/rerank. They pasted the API error body: {"error":"bad_request","message":"invalid items"}. Posting what they sent.

customer-joe: Here's the payload we sent (copied from the client):
```json
{
  "request_id": "abc-123",
  "top_k": null,
  "items": null,
  "candidates": {"0": {"id":"c1","text":"Best tacos"}}
}
```

emma: Hmm — items=null and candidates is an object with numeric keys. Our schema expects items: an array (non-empty) and candidates: an array of candidate objects.

raj: Reproduced locally with a curl against staging, same 400 and message: "items must be a non-empty array". Repro steps below.
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '@bad_payload.json' -i
```

support-bot: INC-4582 created and logs attached (INC-4582). Agent assigned: raj. :eyes:

emma: Customer says this only happens from their browser client using SDK v2.3.1; that SDK serializes empty arrays as null in some code paths. Likely client bug but server should give clearer guidance. @kevin any thoughts on improving our error message? :thinking_face:

raj: Quick notes: our input schema (server-side) rejects explicit null for array fields. We treat missing top_k as fallback to 10 in some older handlers, but explicit null triggers validation failure. For now, recommend they ensure top_k is an integer and items is an array with at least one object. Sent a suggested payload.

emma: Sent this recommended minimal payload back to customer: 
```json
{
  "request_id": "abc-123",
  "top_k": 5,
  "items": [{"id": "q1", "query": "best restaurants"}],
  "candidates": [ {"id": "c1", "text": "Taqueria"}, {"id": "c2", "text": "Pizzeria"} ]
}
```

kevin: Confirming: server-side validations intentionally reject null for arrays to avoid ambiguous behavior. We can make the error message clearer to say: "items must be a non-empty array; do not send null. candidates must be an array. top_k must be integer if provided." Filing a docs task to update examples.

lisa: Customer will patch their client and retest. They said once fixed they get 200. Will close INC-4582 after verification. :white_check_mark:
